text: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE DATA. The Pellham Institute estimates a federal carbon tax is regressive before transfers and progressive after them in 27 of 31 schemes studied. Both claims are true of the same tax, and which one is cited usually reveals the arguer's position rather than the tax's design.

text: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE DATA. Measured leakage in the Ostrander review ranged from 2 to 31 percent of abated emissions, concentrated almost entirely in four trade-exposed sectors.
